caption: The drawing features a single rectangular container with a fitted lid, depicted in a monochromatic, grayscale color scheme. The container is shown in a three-quarter view, revealing two of its sides and the top. Both visible sides display rectangular panels bordered by wavy, raised edges that are darker than the flat surfaces inside the panels. The top of the container slopes slightly upward to a circular, slightly domed lid that sits on a cylindrical neck. The entire surface of the object has a textured appearance, with shading used to indicate a metallic or worn finish. The object is centered on a neutral, light background, which transitions in tone from lighter at the top to slightly darker at the lower edges. There is a signature in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Tea Caddy
